purpose: Eliminate the post-rollout public _next/static 502 window by making public asset readiness a fail-closed part of the exact-SHA production live gate before browser acceptance can begin.
forbiddenChanges: weakening Gekta browser, keyboard, H1, localization or accessibility acceptance
sleep-only workaround or retry inflation that hides a failing public asset
Caddy mutation or production topology change
backend business logic, auth, PostgreSQL or registration mutation
paid external service or new dependency
claiming production PASS while any referenced public static asset returns non-200 or empty content
requiredChecks: six public routes discover Next static assets
JavaScript and CSS asset classes are both present
ten consecutive public rounds have zero 4xx/5xx and non-empty bodies
final route pass remains 200 after the asset window
static evidence records round, route, asset, HTTP status, bytes and timestamp
existing live intake and rollback gates remain fail-closed
maturityBoundary: This scope fixes release/static-delivery readiness only. Gekta issue #4332 still requires production browser evidence and real iPhone/Android keyboard soak before closure.
